camel_example: aliyun dyplsapi CreateSmsSign --region cn-hangzhou --CustomerPoolKey FC50000000000000000000000a1a --CallingNo 15000006539 --CalledNo 17800003614 --ReqId 5640000000000879 --version 2017-05-25 --method POST --force
description_en: Generates a text message delivery tag for scenarios where an employee sends a text message to a customer by using a work number. The client calls this operation to obtain the tag and appends it to the end of the message content. The work number platform then parses the actual called number from the tag and delivers the message to the customer
description_zh: 员工B通过工作号X向客户A下发短信场景中，员工B使用客户端向客户A 发送短信，客户端须通过本接口获取“短信下发标签”，并在短信内容尾部中添加该“标签”。工作号平台通过“标签”解析出真实被叫A号码，下发短信到A号码
name: CreateSmsSign
